<role>

</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

 "problem_statement": "Motor and commercial teams need different routing approaches—automatic by postcode and workload for high-volume cases, manual for complex ones—but the system enforces a single method.    "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater's workspace administration feature allows users to manage permissions, configure settings, and organize teams within their claims environment — all through a centralized, intuitive dashboard.\", \"id\": 4131, \"name\": \"Workspace administration\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"

   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"

 ]

<task>

<output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the core problem of motor and commercial teams needing different claim routing approaches against the provided similar items. The most similar story, 'Document classifier confidence threshold,' is about document categorization rather than routing workflows, and it is unstarted. The remaining items—bulk uploads, workspace administration, supplier contacts, and release notes—are unrelated to claim routing. Therefore, the core problem is not solved by a shipped story or covered by a roadmap item.", "verdict": "pass"}
